portraits.name: 秦岳
portraits.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: individual game character portrait for the Chinese Mars mission narrative game 光速之隔, displayed at 84x84 and 34x34. Style: authentic restrained 64x64 pixel-grid art, square 1:1, bust shot, three-quarter view facing image right (except the explicitly back-view player), pure black background, limited palette of at most 24 colors, crisp hard-edged square pixels, no antialiasing, no blurred gradients. Cool white key light from upper left, thin signal red (#ff3b30) rim light on the right, sci-fi mission-control terminal aesthetic. Use large simple readable pixel clusters for the face, eyes and clothing; frame the head prominently with chest in the lower part and a small black margin, so features remain identifiable at 34 pixels. Final image should visually resemble a native 64x64 sprite enlarged with nearest-neighbor pixels. No text, letters, numerals, logos, flags, watermark, border, UI, collage or other characters. A single complete standalone portrait, edge-to-edge square image. Do not add decorative scenery; any requested screen silhouettes must be extremely faint and keep the background mostly black.
Subject for this single portrait: Chinese man, 63 years old, full white hair, thin reading glasses, worn dark jacket, slightly furrowed brow, complicated thoughtful gaze, faint mission-control screen silhouettes behind.
